error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
error.device_not_found: Device not found. Make sure it is powered on and in range.

user.title: Select a Surplife BLE light
user.description: Choose a discovered device from the list, or select manual entry.

manual.title: Add a Surplife BLE light manually
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address (MAC or UUID) of your device. You can find it with a BLE scanner app or the ble-rgb scan command.

upload_animation.name: Upload animation
upload_animation.description: Upload an image or animated GIF to the curtain and play it. The animation is stored in the curtain's flash memory (at most 128 frames of 20x20) and keeps playing without Bluetooth. Every upload writes the flash, so do not call this often.

path.name: File path
path.description: Local image file (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP). The directory must be allowed in allowlist_external_dirs. Use this or URL.

url.name: URL
url.description: http(s) address of an image or GIF, at most 5 MB. Use this or File path.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Playback speed from 1 (slow, about 5 seconds per frame) to 100 (very fast).

mode.name: Play mode
mode.description: 0 and 1 loop all frames (1 is what the Surplife app sends). 2 and up hold frame 1.

controller_side.name: Controller side
controller_side.description: Which side of the picture the controller box hangs on. The curtain has no front or back. Leave empty to use the Controller side option of the device.

flip.name: Flip vertically
flip.description: Swap top and bottom for a curtain that hangs upside down. Leave empty to use the Upside down option of the device.

max_frames.name: Maximum frames
max_frames.description: Fail if the animation has more frames than this. The curtain holds at most 128.

resample.name: Resize filter
resample.description: How the picture is scaled down to 20x20.

play_animation.name: Play animation
play_animation.description: Play the animation stored in the curtain's flash memory.

mode.name: Play mode
mode.description: 0 and 1 loop all frames. 2 and up hold frame 1.

init.title: Curtain options
init.description: Set how the IOTBT curtain is hung and adjust how colors look. The orientation is the default for every image upload. The curtain stores colors in a coarse HSV format and its LEDs differ from a screen. Use `ble-rgb curtain calibrate` to find good color values. A gain or gamma of 1.0 changes nothing.

data_description.red_gain: Multiplier for the red channel, from 0.0 to 2.0.
data_description.green_gain: Multiplier for the green channel, from 0.0 to 2.0. LED green is strong, so values below 1.0 often look better.
data_description.blue_gain: Multiplier for the blue channel, from 0.0 to 2.0.
data_description.gamma: Applied to every channel before the gains, from 0.2 to 4.0. Values above 1.0 darken dark tones.
data_description.controller_side: Which side of the picture the controller box is on when you look at the curtain. Choose right if the controller hangs on the right, so images are mirrored to appear upright.
data_description.flip: Swap top and bottom for a curtain that hangs upside down.

error.invalid_calibration: The values are outside the allowed range.
error.invalid_orientation: Choose left or right for the controller side.

abort.not_curtain: Color calibration is only available for IOTBT curtain lights.
